riskBoundaries.statement: Named classes, declaration exports and the two direct physical module paths are intentionally retired. External users importing them must migrate; unknown external use is not evidence of zero use.

The namespace key set at domain/core/backend barrels changes. Current AST has no candidate read or whole namespace escape/enumeration; source tests and tools do not assert these keys. Do not claim a byte-identical or arbitrary reflective environment.

Removes domain barrel edges to two leaf modules and their syntax-level dependencies. Class definitions have no top-level World, clock, registry registration or phase advancement. Module initialization/namespace/declaration and CJS wrapper topology nonetheless changes; no cold/runtime equivalence has been executed.
No actual phase progression or condition evaluation algorithm is migrated. PM, ConditionRegistry, mechanism win registry and terminal policy retain their current responsibility and call order.

Both source paths and the new domain/index header belong to engine-fingerprint backend/src coverage, so a newly generated sourceHash changes. Strict recorded identity/validation and historical archives retain their original values; no historical rewrite or exemption.
Keep historical generated source/export inventory and debt evidence unchanged. The new API surface should be documented in a new implementation batch, not retroactively normalized.

AST first read ran with a020 HEAD plus pending component/gateway comments. The entire 1948-source parse input matches now-fixed 64479b4c Git byte digest; the three candidate before texts are captured from actual 64479b4c.
